uncited: **Data Transmission:** The geometry unit transmits sample density and gradient values to the ray-casting units over a dedicated bus.
**Buffering:** DSPs receive these values from an asynchronous FIFO buffer.
**DSP Processing:** Each DSP computes the interaction of light and material for each volume element.
**Result Collection:** A local master CPU collects all scanlines from the DSP memories and transfers the final image results to the host system.
The core pipeline implements the emission-absorption optical model using front-to-back compositing [Parent].
